App.name: SokoFresh
App.tagline: Stock, orders and payments in one place.

Phone.label: Phone number
Phone.invalid: Check the number. It should look like 0712 345 678.

Orders.emptyBody: Orders from your link, phone calls, WhatsApp and walk-ins will all show here.

Stock.emptyBody: Add what you sell and its price. Customers will see it on your order link.

Payments.emptyBody: Record cash, M-Pesa and bank payments here to see who has paid and who owes.

More.designHint: See every button and label on this phone

Design.intro: Example screens with made-up data, to check how things look on this phone.
Design.sheetBody: Sheets slide up from the bottom for quick choices. Tap outside or the X to close.

Offline.title: You're offline
Offline.body: This page hasn't been saved on this phone yet. Connect to the internet and try again.
Offline.savedAt: Showing what was saved at {time}. Changes need a connection.
Offline.savedUnknown: Showing the last saved copy. Changes need a connection.

Login.title: Log in
Login.phoneHint: We'll send a 6-digit code to this number on WhatsApp. No password needed.
Login.codeSent: We sent a code on WhatsApp to {phone}.

errors.invalid_phone: Check the number. It should look like 0712 345 678.
errors.too_many: Too many tries. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.send_failed: We couldn't send the code. Check the number and try again.
errors.invalid_code: That code is not right. Check WhatsApp and try again.
errors.expired: That code has expired. Tap "Send again".

Welcome.title: Set up your business
Welcome.body: You're logged in as {phone}, but this number isn't part of a business yet.
Welcome.staffHint: Work for a supplier? Ask the owner to add this number as staff, then log in again.
